title: Insurance Company
bottom_line: The analysis concludes this is feasible if the private insurance market expands from 600,000 to 1 million people over three years (400,000 net switch from public to private insurance) and the company maintains its 10% market share. Quantitative targets: 100,000 new privately insured customers, $20 million incremental profits in 3 years, requiring $2,000 average premium per customer.
